hints.title: Two Candidate Targets
hints.text: We seek two numbers whose product is num + 1 or num + 2, with minimum absolute difference.

hints.title: Square Root Search Downwards
hints.text: For an integer target, start looking for factors from floor(sqrt(target)) down to 1.

hints.title: First Factor is Closest
hints.text: The first factor d found walking downwards from sqrt(target) maximizes d and minimizes abs(d - target // d).

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing factors starting upwards from 1 takes O(N) instead of stopping quickly from the square root.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Decremental scan from sqrt(N) finds the closest factor pair in O(sqrt(N)) worst case.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks both num + 1 and num + 2 and searches downwards from floor(sqrt).
complexity.notes: math.isqrt handles integer square roots precisely.
